_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the P2 fixture geometry. index.js renders from it and tools/ci-p2.sh probes from it, so a change to one cannot silently disagree with the other. Colors are exact sRGB with no alpha blending, so a probe expects the literal byte values.

boxes._why: square with no radius: the baseline 'a View becomes pixels' probe
radius 20: corner probe must show BACKGROUND. Catches a renderer that draws every View as a plain rect - which looks correct in a screenshot thumbnail and is wrong.
child positioned relative to its parent, so a renderer that ignores parent origin paints it in the wrong place and this probe reads background

label._why: text through Impeller's typography engine. Probed as 'ink present in this band', not an exact pixel, because glyph rasterisation is not byte-stable across font stacks.
label._whyMeasured: INK IS NOT ENOUGH. A TextLayoutManager returning 0x0 (RN's platform/cxx stub) still paints glyphs at the node origin, so the ink band passes while Yoga has laid the node out as a zero-sized box. Mutation M4 proved exactly that. These bounds assert the MEASUREMENT, and are wide because glyph advances vary by font.
